content.comment_body: Hello. Is there a way to download and add more components to [product_name]? The current number of 12 components is not sufficient for my needs. Is it possible to create custom components?
With [product_name]? No, that's not possible. You would need to develop your own [product_name] to achieve that.
So I would need to write my own program? That's not really what I wanted.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsatisfied with the limited component options (only 12) available in [product_name]. They would like the ability to expand or customize the component library, but it is not currently supported. This restriction leads to user frustration, especially for those who need more flexible solutions for their projects.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to support an expandable component library either by allowing downloads of new components or enabling custom creation, so that their project needs can be better accommodated.
